chunks: Fight them so that God may punish them at your hands, and put them to shame, and help you against them, and heal the wounds of the hearts of believers,

key_terms.بِأَيْدِيكُمْ: At your hands / by your agency
key_terms.يُخْزِهِمْ: Put them to shame / disgrace them

ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual and physical benefits of fighting mentioned in Surah At-Tawbah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a divine promise that the physical exertion of jihad serves as a means to purify the believers' hearts from the distress of seeing their enemies prevail. The 'healing of the chests' (shifa' sudur) refers to the removal of anxiety and grief, linking military action directly to spiritual tranquility and the validation of faith. This connects the external struggle with the internal state of the community, emphasizing that victory is not merely territorial but also emotional and theological.
